articles.title: Spotlight: Some F1 broadcasters choose not to attend Qatar Grand Prix | Brief
articles.teaser: Some F1 broadcasters have not sent teams to Qatar

digest: Coverage centred on Kimi Antonelli, described as the newly crowned 2026 world champion, comfortably topping first practice at the Qatar Grand Prix ahead of Mercedes team-mate George Russell for a 1-2, as drivers grappled with the tricky Lusail circuit (Motorsport.com, Autosport). RaceFans emphasised his margin, calling him emphatically quickest by half a second on the medium tyre compound. Away from the track, RaceFans also noted that some F1 broadcasters had chosen not to send teams to Qatar.
